summary: Generic bug-replay eval cases: any upstream fix becomes a TC1-style case (base, ticket, withheld set, scorer) from one spec file
description:
[claude] Owner requirement (2026-11-03): the solution must be generic and scalable, not hardcoded for the demo.

## Today (hardcoded to one bug)

* Base branch `tc1/5776-base` was built by hand on the rtems mirror.
* `scripts/tc1_dry_run.py` embeds the RTEMS-1 ticket text and `UPSTREAM_FILES`.
* `scripts/score_tc1.py` (PR #43) hardcodes commit `a62e60b5` and `mutexinit.c`.
* `anvil/kb/config.py` hardcodes the TC1 withheld issue/MR/commit IDs as constants.

## Target

One spec file per case, e.g. `cases/rtems-5776.yaml`: repo, upstream issue(s), fix commit(s), withheld IDs (issues, MRs, commit prefixes), ticket title/body (symptoms only, never the fix), and the build/test commands.

A `case` CLI that:

1. creates the base branch on the mirror at the parent of the first fix commit (pre-fix state), verified to build;
2. creates the Jira ticket from the spec (with the required "Code base: branch ..." line);
3. scores a finished run against the withheld fix (files hit, hunk overlap, regression test present and failing on base / passing on head).

The KB leak guard reads its withheld set from **all** case files (union), not constants. The dry-run and scorer scripts take `--case`.

## Acceptance

* RTEMS-1 / 5776 expressed as a case spec; existing behaviour unchanged (same base SHA, same exclusions).
* A second real upstream RTEMS fix added as a case with **no code changes**, base built and ticket created by the CLI.
* Tests for spec parsing, the exclusion union, and the scorer on fixture diffs.

comments.body:
[claude] PR #48 (stacked on #47).

* `cases/rtems-5776.toml` + `anvil.cases` (list / show / withheld / build-base / ticket).
* build-base rebuilds `tc1/5776-base` from the spec with an **identical tree**: `a62e60b5^` + 5 infra files overlaid.
* The KB guard now takes the union over case files (identical to the old TC1 lists, tested). `tc1_dry_run.py --case`.
* Open: the case-driven scorer (devin, on #43), a second real case, and enforcing `as_of` in KB search (time-based leak guard).

[claude] Merged #48 (case specs, base builder, KB guard from cases) and #49 (devin: case-driven scorer, `score_tc1.py --case`, `tc1_dry_run.py` scores via the case).

Acceptance status:

* RTEMS-1/5776 as a case spec, with identical base tree and identical exclusions: **done**.
* Tests for spec, union and scorer: **done**.
* A second real upstream fix as a case with no code changes: **open**.

Also open: enforce `as_of` in KB search for eval runs (a time-based leak guard).

[claude] Split the remaining acceptance into tickets of their own:

* **ANVIL-42** (devin): a second real case with no code changes.
* **ANVIL-43** (claude): enforce `as_of` in KB search.

The core of this ticket is merged (#48, #49), so I'm closing it.
